about: Missions Scout has finished. The Operations Vault window moves matching Pending missions to Complete.

complete.title: Complete log: Last 24 hours, Past 7 days, All time
complete.text: After every 24hrs I want the mission complete log to move into a sub catigory of the past 7 days then all time]. once a 24 hour period has finsihed I want any finished missions to move inot either the last 7 days log catigory or the all missions complete catigory I want every mission log to have a date and title and then a dropdown of the mission.
complete.note: Complete tab now groups logs into Last 24 hours, Past 7 days, and All time, each with date, title, and a dropdown

complete.text: Every mission that is started after they are finished I want them to go in the complete section so I know when it is done
complete.note: Finished missions now move to Complete automatically
complete.title: Finished missions move to Complete

complete.text: Now cretae a room for the trader Bot and make him sleep in a bed in his own room and when we are ready to trade he will get up and go to a computer in his room. When he waked up he gets a report from the analyst and market scanner.
complete.note: Paper Trader now has his own quarters with a cot and a trading desk; he wakes on Start paper trading and gets reports from Market Scanner and Technical Analyst
